items.question: Who supplies the vegetables for your restaurant?
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：问句或陈述是“Who supplies the vegetables for your restaurant?”，自然应答是“Some local farmers.”。选择理由：该项在语义和会话功能上直接承接前句；其余选项只是词汇相关、时态不合或答非所问。正确答案：B（Some local farmers.）。
